metadata.host: memory terminal output with native Node clock; no PTY/terminal-emulator presentation latency
metadata.workload: full incident workbench, unique literal trace queries plus character-by-character input and Escape, input through handleInput and committed frame; setup/index construction measured separately
metadata.limitations: Shared cloud CPU; polling adds up to ~1ms plus scheduling to final results. Two warmups precede unique, uncached measured queries. Module setup and initial/palette frames are measured separately; process launch and terminal-emulator presentation are excluded.

setup.clockBoundary: moduleTo* starts immediately before the dynamic application-module import and includes host/runtime creation; process launch and earlier static framework/harness imports are excluded. Table preparation and first picker opening overlap.

memory.note: Whole process including dataset/index, runtime; benchmark observer discards historical frames and written bytes; not library-only allocations

allocation.note: Sampled cumulative allocation includes collected objects; reported sites own exclusive bytes. Raw inspector profiles are saved beside the report and released before heap observations. Forced-GC observations retain the active application and source. These are separate from unsampled latency runs.
